searchText: Hi, everyone, now that blocks are deterministic in time beetwen one another, could we increase GasLimit? Maybe by a good 50% at least just wondering If I am not mistaken having two blocks too close to each other was one of the reason GasLimit was not increased for a while I don't believe this was the dominant reason for having a 15M gas target. When this particular topic was brought up, someone almost always countered that "on average" is what matters, because even if you can't process a short block in time, there will eventually be a long block during which you can catch up. IMO, the reason to lower the gas limit (or at least keep it where it is) is because of DB growth rates. It was not the dominant one but I think it was still one of the main points Hmm, I may be mis-remembering, but I don't think it was a main point of any of the core devs? It was frequently brought up by people wanting to increasing the gas limit, but I don't remember the core devs ever agreeing it was a real problem/roadblock? FYI: made some (primarily presentation) updates to EIP-4895 https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4895 i know some teams are looking to implement soon so wanted to call it out ahead of the next ACD, feel free to reach out to me w/ any questions etc before then We will also need to extend devp2p `eth` to gossip the withdrawals, right? they will not need to be gossiped they can only be validated from the consensus layer so in general the EL will only apply withdrawals coming from the CL via the engine API the one exception is syncing previous blocks and the devp2p protocol will need to be extended to accommodate the extended execution payload/block definition in the EIP RE: Shanghai, going forward will forks happen at certain CL slots/epochs or certain EL blocks? CLs need to fork on epoch boundaries AIUI, and we _could_ keep using blocks for the EL, but timestamps might be more precise? If we use blocks, then there might be a lag between the CL and EL fork of several slots given missed proposals. Timestamps would make it such that the same/next EL block as the CL slot would activate the fork.
